LESSON: IMITATIVE SPEAKING

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Listening and Speaking
Topic 1.5: Imitative Speaking
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Imitative Speaking, part of Listening and Speaking in Grade 5 MANDARIN.

Key inquiry question: What is effective communication? 2. Who is an effective communicator?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. watch an audio-visual clip on vocabulary related to hobbies and interests(画画、跳 舞、唱歌、听音乐、看书、玩儿电子游 戏)and repeat saying the words,

2. listen to a recording and match the pictures related to hobbies and interests to their correct pinyin and Chinese characters,

3. sing along the hobbies and likes song (爱 好歌) with their peers,

4. act out a verb related to hobbies/interests as the others say out the appropriate word,

5. respond to simple questions on hobbies and interests in turns(你的爱好是什么? 我的 爱好是......你喜欢做什么?我喜欢......),

6. describe their hobbies/interests and those of their friends using verb 喜欢 in turns, 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. watch an audio-visual clip on vocabulary related to hobbies and interests(画画、跳 舞、唱歌、听音乐、看书、玩儿电子游 戏)and repeat saying the words,
2. listen to a recording and match the pictures related to hobbies and interests to their correct pinyin and Chinese characters,
3. sing along the hobbies and likes song (爱 好歌) with their peers,
4. act out a verb related to hobbies/interests as the others say out the appropriate word,
5. respond to simple questions on hobbies and interests in turns(你的爱好是什么? 我的 爱好是......你喜欢做什么?我喜欢......),
6. describe their hobbies/interests and those of their friends using verb 喜欢 in turns, 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Imitative Speaking together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Self-efficacy: The learner identifies who they are and what activities they love to do as they share their hobbies and interests.

● Communication and Collaboration: The learner speaks clearly and effectively using appropriate language, expressions and

gestures as they talk about the hobbies and interests of their friends.

Values:
Respect: The learner displays acceptance of the varied opinions and views of their peers as they talk about their hobbies and

interests.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Self-awareness: The learner understands self and can easily recognise what their preferences and dislikes are in regard to

hobbies and interests.

Link to other learning areas:

The learner can link their learning to Creative Arts on the skill of expressing oneself using varied creative forms.
